title: Shipping labels: carrier spans in a batched call land in the wrong trace
name: Batched label tracing

questions.prompt: Since label requests started being batched into one carrier call, our traces look wrong at peak times: one customer's label request shows several carrier calls for other shipments, while other requests show no carrier call at all, so we can't tell which requests were slowed by the carrier. Fix LabelBatcher so the tests pass, keeping one carrier call per batch.
